parts.question: German AX-17 guidance before latest revision?

result.answer:
Before the latest revision (DE-AX17-LBL-042), the German guidance for AX-17 was provided by DE-AX17-LBL-038, which was in effect from 03-Feb-2025 to 15-Sep-2026 [E3]. This document was superseded on 15-Sep-2026 [E3].

According to this historical guidance, the renal dosing for AX-17 was as follows:
*   Normal renal category: 50 mg OD [E2]
*   Mild renal category: 50 mg OD [E2]
*   Moderate renal category: 50 mg OD [E2]
*   Severe renal category: Not recommended [E2]

Specifically, the historical fact for moderate renal impairment starting dose was 50 mg once daily [E3].
